title: Breaded Veal Schnitzel with Warm Potato Salad
summary: Pounded veal escalopes are coated in crumbs and shallow-fried until deep golden and crisp, served with lemon, lingonberry sauce and a tangy warm potato salad.
equipment: 2 sheets baking paper or a freezer bag

ingredients.item: veal escalopes from the leg (about 150 g each)
fine sea salt or table salt
sunflower or vegetable oil, for shallow-frying
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins in unsalted water for 18-22 min, until a knife slides in with only slight resistance. Drain, peel while still warm and slice 5 mm thick into the bowl.

steps.title: Dress while warm
steps.text: Whisk the hot stock with the onion, vinegar, sugar, mustard powder and salad salt, then pour over the potatoes. Leave for 15 min, stirring gently twice, until the liquid is absorbed; warm potato starch soaks up the dressing and turns creamy. Fold in the oil and chives and serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Flatten the veal
steps.text: Place each escalope between baking paper and pound evenly to 4-5 mm. Season both sides with the schnitzel salt and white pepper. An even thickness means the meat cooks through in the time the crust takes to brown.

steps.title: Set up and coat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 100°C (fan 80°C) for keeping the schnitzels warm. Put the flour, the eggs beaten with the milk, and the breadcrumbs in three shallow dishes. Dredge each escalope in flour, shake off the excess, dip in the egg and let it drip, then lay it in the crumbs and coat lightly without pressing, so the crust can puff into loose waves. Fry straight away.

steps.title: Shallow-fry
steps.text: Heat the oil in the frying pan to 170-175°C, when a crumb sizzles at once, and add 10 g of the butter. Fry 1-2 schnitzels at a time for 1.5-2 min per side, swirling the pan so hot fat washes over the top, until deep golden and cooked through (at least 63°C in the thickest part). The swirling fat steams the egg layer, lifting the crumb away from the meat.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest each schnitzel for 3 min on the kitchen paper, then keep it warm in the oven while you fry the rest, adding more butter for each batch. Serve with lemon wedges, the potato salad and lingonberry sauce. Allow the frying oil to cool completely before disposing of it.

tips: A common mistake is pressing the breadcrumbs on firmly; a light touch lets the coating puff and ripple.
Coat the veal just before frying, as a coating left to sit turns soggy and will not lift.
Keep the oil at 170-175°C: cooler oil makes greasy schnitzels, hotter oil burns the crumb before the veal is done.
Dress the potatoes while they are still warm so they absorb the flavour fully.
storage: Schnitzel is best freshly fried. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours for up to 2 days and reheat in a hot oven until piping hot (74°C). The potato salad keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days.
